title: Holding Several Certificate Subscriptions
content:
**Clause — Number of subscriptions held.** Under the Harborline terms for SSL/TLS Certificates, a customer may hold any number of certificate subscriptions. There is no limit on the number of subscriptions one customer may hold, and several subscriptions may cover the same name, for example where different servers need separate keys.

**Clause — Independence of each subscription.** Each certificate subscription is billed, validated, renewed and refunded on its own. A charge, a validation, a renewal or a refund recorded on one subscription belongs to that subscription only and does not carry over to another subscription of the same customer, even where both cover the same name.

### The clause restated

| Question the clause answers | What the clause provides |
|---|---|
| Is there a ceiling on how many SSL/TLS Certificates subscriptions one customer holds? | No. Any number may be held. |
| May two subscriptions secure the same name? | Yes, for example where different servers need separate keys. |
| Is a second subscription for the same name billed with the first? | No. Each subscription is billed on its own. |
| Is validation, renewal or refund shared between them? | No. Each subscription is validated, renewed and refunded on its own. |

### Illustration (hypothetical)

A hypothetical customer holds two subscriptions for the name portal.example, one for each of two servers that use separate keys. Under this clause both subscriptions are permitted. Each has its own billing lines, its own validation dates, its own renewal and its own refund position: a refund on the first subscription leaves the second subscription's charges and dates as they are.
